newsitem.title: USA: Four crew presumed dead in Miami crash.
newsitem.headline: Four crew presumed dead in Miami crash.

text.p: All four crew aboard a Fine Air DC-8 cargo jet that crashed Thursday seconds after takeoff from Miami International Airport were presumed dead, authorities said.
"We have confirmed from the flight manifest that there were in fact four people on board. All four individuals are presumed dead at this time," Dade County Mayor Alex Penelas said.
Penelas said authorities at the scene had only "confirmed three bodies."

He also said there had been no confirmed deaths on the ground, which he called "very, very lucky." The plane went down in a crowded commercial district of warehouses and shops just west of the airport.
Two people on the ground were treated for minor injuries.
A National Transportation Safety Board official said there had been no emergency transmission from the crew before the plane crashed.
